title: Poland says it plans to proceed with a digital services tax of up to 3% on large digital platforms, despite threats of retaliation like tariffs from the US (Agnieszka Barteczko/Bloomberg)
summary: Agnieszka Barteczko / Bloomberg: Poland says it plans to proceed with a digital services tax of up to 3% on large digital platforms, despite threats of retaliation like tariffs from the US — Poland will continue working on legislation to tax digital platforms, Finance Minister Andrzej Domanski said, despite threats …
